SPACE HEX TACTICS

Assemble both fleets. You command every ship on your side unless you hand it to the AI.
8 impulses per turn; spend energy and fire at any impulse. Velocity carries over until you burn to change it. Burn 2 (reverse 4) for cruisers, half that for frigates/destroyers, one per impulse; cruisers must burn straight after a turn or slip; frigates/destroyers can't repeat a turn or a slip back to back; pivot 2 per facing (frigates/destroyers 0.5).
Shield generator at 25/50/75/100% (full cost: heavy cruiser 10 energy per turn, cruiser 7.5, frigate/destroyer 5); below 100% shields are capped at that share, regenerate proportionally slower, and can't be reinforced or repaired; if it goes off, shields collapse to 0. Regeneration: none if hit in the last 4 impulses, base rate if hit in the last 12, double otherwise; reinforce or repair base shields at 2 energy per point (max 2 points/impulse; reinforcement lasts one turn, up to 2× shields). Loading a weapon readies it one turn later (TL5 laser cannons: half a turn). Battles start at battle stations (everything loaded) unless you choose weapons cold.
Heavy cruisers: reactor 42, 50 shields / 150 hull · Albatross: reactor 30, 40 / 110 · Dogahr Light Cruiser: reactor 28, 35 / 90 · Dogahr Destroyers: reactor 22, 28 / 64 · Peregrine: reactor 22, 25 / 60 · Dogahr Frigate: reactor 20, 20 / 48.
